description: Join a dedicated team at a skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. roleTitle: Therapist (OT, PT, ST) / Therapy Assistant (COTA, PTA)
description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care. We are actively seeking skilled Occupational Therapists, Physical Therapists, Speech Therapists, Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants, and Physical Therapist Assistants to enhance our dynamic therapy team. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents, helping them achieve their rehabilitation goals in a supportive and collaborative environment. We offer flexible full-time and part-time positions, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life. You'll work alongside a compassionate team committed to clinical excellence and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and eager to contribute to a facility that values its staff and patients, we encourage you to apply. Take the next step in your career with a facility that supports your growth and provides competitive compensation for your expertise.
requirements: Current state licensure/certification as an Occupational Therapist (OT), Physical Therapist (PT), Speech Therapist (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA).
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Commitment to providing high-quality patient-centered care.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA roles ranges from $28.00 - $37.00/hr, while OT/PT/ST roles offer $40.00 - $46.00/hr. Compensation based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, compensation based on experience.
